sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:20

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:20:1
items.html: Reaching and not reaching, and these two aspects are called expansion and departure, in which the four phases will be completed: That is, the four letters of the name HaVaYaH. For these two aspects of expansion and departure of the first expansion of Akudim, which he brought above in item 19, are the two letters Yod and Hey of HaVaYaH. And these two aspects of expansion and departure in the second expansion of Akudim, which are called reaching and not reaching, are the two letters Vav and Hey of HaVaYaH. As the ARI writes before us.

items.html: The light reaches within the vessel of Keter, etc.: It will be explained further on.
